description: To release a foreign-run hold, Maya must copy 'run:thread:thr_01JD8M4Q:ordinal:6' out of the middle of the hold sentence into a free-text 'Reviewed runs' field. Pardner already knows exactly which runs are unreviewed.
expected: One checkbox per unreviewed run ('I reviewed run 6'), prefilled from the hold.
actual: A free-text field. Omitting the ID costs a failed release (UNREVIEWED_RUN).
suggested_fix: Expose the unreviewed run IDs in the snapshot's holds and render them as checkboxes, with a link to each run in T3.

description: The hold asks Maya to 'review before reuse', but Pardner shows nothing about the foreign run: no output, status or direct link to the run. Pardner does capture output for its own runs.
expected: The foreign run's status, captured output and a 'View in T3' link, in the hold.
actual: Only the run ID in a sentence. Reviewing means opening the thread in T3 and finding the run.
suggested_fix: Read the foreign run's items like owned runs and show them read-only under the hold.
